name: 18938 · New Hope, PA
findings: ZIP 18938 (New Hope) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18938 (New Hope) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18938 (New Hope) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
